caption: The video captures a wide beach scene under a low sun just above the sea horizon near the center. Its bright light casts a vertical glittering reflection across the wet, rock-strewn tidal sand. Two dark silhouetted shrub-like plants frame the left and right edges, while the sky grades from deep blue through a pale cloud band to orange near the horizon. The framing appears stationary throughout the view, with no visible cut. Small dark specks drift across the upper and middle sky, changing position. The sun reflection remains a bright broken path on the damp sand. The overall landscape stays largely steady, with the sun and horizon holding their places. The moving specks are the clearest signs of motion in this continuous coastal view.
